shots.scene: wide aerial view at golden sunrise over a temperate countryside: open woodland, rolling meadows, a winding dirt road connecting two small villages with red roofs, morning mist in the valleys, distant low mountains
shots.framing: very wide establishing shot, horizon in upper third, lots of empty sky on the left

shots.scene: adult Bulbasaur standing in three-quarter side view facing right
shots.framing: whole body centered, generous margin around it, bulb and feet clearly visible

shots.scene: a NEWLY HATCHED baby Bulbasaur, far smaller and rounder than an adult, wet glistening skin, eyes half open, sitting among broken cream-colored eggshell fragments in a nest of dry leaves on the forest floor; on its back there is NO bulb yet, only a single tiny green seed the size of a pea
shots.framing: low macro angle at ground level, soft dappled morning light
shots.refNote: ref s02 để giữ màu da/đốm, nhưng prompt phải nói rõ là con non — lần thử đầu ra con trưởng thành vì bám ref quá sát

shots.scene: a Bulbasaur asleep, lying flat on warm short grass in a sunny forest clearing, eyes closed, the bulb on its back catching bright sunlight, dust particles glowing in the sunbeams
shots.framing: medium-wide shot from slightly above, subject on the right third, sunbeams from upper left

shots.scene: real-life emerald green sea slug Elysia chlorotica, leaf-shaped body with visible fine veins, resting on a rock in clear shallow seawater, sunlight rippling through the water
shots.framing: macro underwater photograph, subject centered

shots.scene: a clutch of five cream-colored eggs with small green spots in a shallow ground nest under dense forest shade, ferns around, one narrow beam of light falling on a single egg
shots.framing: medium shot at ground level, moody shadow, the lit egg on the left third

shots.scene: an Ivysaur walking slowly through tall summer meadow grass, the heavy pink bud on its back slightly swollen, faint pollen drifting from the bud into the warm air
shots.framing: telephoto side view, subject walking left to right, meadow background softly blurred

shots.scene: two adult Venusaur standing side by side in the same pose, viewed from slightly above so the center of each flower is clearly visible; LEFT is male (flower center open and empty), RIGHT is female (a distinct seed-like pistil standing in the flower center)
shots.framing: both full bodies in frame with equal size and spacing, symmetrical composition

shots.scene: a Venusaur standing in a wet meadow just after rain, raindrops beading on the big flower and leaves, low clouds breaking, two Butterfree drifting toward the flower
shots.framing: medium-wide shot, subject lower center, Butterfree in the upper right, soft grey-gold light

shots.scene: a Bulbasaur at the foot of a fruit tree, two long green vines extended from under its bulb, reaching up and gently picking round red berries from a branch
shots.framing: vertical action in a 16:9 frame: subject at bottom left, vines leading to berries at upper right

shots.scene: an adult Bulbasaur gently wrapping one vine around a much smaller frightened young Bulbasaur in tall grass at dusk, calming it, the small one leaning against the adult
shots.framing: close medium shot at their eye level, warm backlight

shots.scene: a Bulbasaur crouched on a mossy rock at the edge of a calm forest pond, one vine dipped into the water, ripples spreading, a small silver fish near the vine tip
shots.framing: wide shot, reflection of the Bulbasaur in the still water, subject on the left third

shots.scene: at night in light rain, a small orange lizard-like Charmander sheltering under a rock ledge, the flame on the tip of its tail still burning, steam rising where raindrops hit the flame
shots.framing: dark moody shot, the tail flame is the main light source, subject small on the right, lots of darkness

shots.scene: the edge where an old broadleaf forest meets an open meadow at first light, long grass wet with dew, a narrow animal trail pressed into the grass, mist between the trunks
shots.framing: wide establishing shot from ground level, trail leading from lower left into the trees

shots.scene: five Bulbasaur of different sizes scattered across a sunlit clearing, each lying in its own patch of sunlight, well spaced apart, one in the foreground sharp and the rest softly out of focus
shots.framing: long telephoto shot compressing the clearing, foreground subject on the left third

shots.scene: a Venusaur lying beside a shallow ground nest of cream-colored eggs in deep forest shade, its big flower spread above the nest like a roof, watchful eyes half closed
shots.framing: low medium-wide shot, nest in the lower left, flower filling the upper frame

shots.scene: two Bulbasaur pressing shoulder to shoulder inside one small patch of sunlight on the forest floor, both trying to keep their bulbs in the light, mouths open in a low warning
shots.framing: eye-level medium shot, hard shaft of light isolating them against dark undergrowth

shots.scene: four Bulbasaur lying in a loose ring in a warm clearing at midday, all asleep, bulbs turned toward the sun, dust and pollen floating in the air
shots.framing: slightly high wide shot looking down on the ring

shots.scene: two Bulbasaur facing each other, a single vine from each one meeting and curling together in the air between them, like two elephants touching trunks
shots.framing: close shot centered on the two vines meeting, faces softly blurred behind

shots.scene: one adult Ivysaur resting in tall grass with three very small Bulbasaur gathered against its flank and under its leaves, late afternoon light
shots.framing: medium-wide shot at their eye level

shots.scene: a Fearow diving out of a bright sky with wings half folded toward a Bulbasaur that is flattening itself against the ground under a fern, motion blur on the wings
shots.framing: dynamic wide shot, bird in the upper right, prey in the lower left, dramatic backlight

shots.scene: a Bulbasaur with its bulb open at the top releasing a dense cloud of fine pale spores into the air, the spores drifting and catching low sunlight, a large bird silhouette unsteady in the haze behind
shots.framing: backlit medium shot so the spore cloud glows, subject on the left

shots.scene: extreme close-up of small green barbed seeds hooked into coarse animal fur, tiny root threads just starting to grip, shallow focus
shots.framing: macro shot, seeds filling the frame

shots.scene: a line of four-toed footprints pressed into wet grey mud beside a pond, each print about the size of a human palm, water slowly seeping into the freshest one, a faint drag mark between prints
shots.framing: high angle looking straight down, prints running diagonally across the frame

shots.scene: adult Ivysaur standing in three-quarter side view facing right, body low and braced, thick sturdy legs clearly visible under the heavy bud
shots.framing: whole body centered, generous margin around it, legs and bud clearly visible

shots.scene: an Ivysaur with the heavy bud on its back trying to rise, front legs braced wide, belly close to the ground, muscles of the shoulders bunched, churned earth under its feet
shots.framing: low front-quarter shot, emphasising the weight pressing it down

shots.scene: close shot of the swollen pink bud of an Ivysaur, the seams between petals just parting, small insects and one Butterfree-like creature hovering close to the scent
shots.framing: tight shot on the bud, body out of focus below

shots.scene: an Ivysaur lying stretched out in an open patch of sun in the middle of the day, eyes shut, while the shadow of the forest edge creeps toward it
shots.framing: wide shot with a strong diagonal line between sunlight and shadow

shots.scene: at dusk in a hidden hollow ringed by old trees, about a dozen Bulbasaur and Ivysaur standing in a loose circle, a soft green light rising from their bulbs and buds, one huge Venusaur silhouetted at the edge
shots.framing: wide shot from slightly above, warm green glow as the only light

shots.scene: three Venusaur walking in single file across an open autumn grassland toward low sun, flowers tilted toward the light, long shadows behind them
shots.framing: very wide shot, the line of animals small in the lower third

shots.scene: a resting Venusaur in a meadow with two smaller creatures that had been fighting now sitting quietly a few steps away in the drifting scent, petals releasing a faint visible haze
shots.framing: medium-wide shot, Venusaur on the right, the two small creatures on the left

shots.scene: a very old Venusaur resting at the forest edge, its trunk gone woody and cracked with moss and small ferns growing on its back and shell, the flower huge and slightly faded
shots.framing: close medium shot, texture of moss and bark clearly readable, soft rainy light

extraCreatures.charmander: Charmander, a small bipedal orange lizard-like creature about 0.6 m tall with a cream belly and a burning flame on the tip of its tail
extraCreatures.butterfree: Butterfree, a butterfly-like creature with large white wings with black veins and a purple body
extraCreatures.fearow: Fearow, a large brown bird-like creature with a very long thin beak, a red crest and broad wings
extraCreatures.caterpie: Caterpie, a small green caterpillar-like creature with a yellow underside and a red antenna on its head
